source: Intercepted existing Task query/detail DTOs through production Inbox
limits: Synthetic reads do not prove actual SQLite snapshot or Provider behavior.
Chrome viewports and composing events are not real-device or IME certification.
Poisoned Bootstrap counters intentionally differ from authoritative Inbox results.
checks: desktop: 90 eligible Task-latest records use exact20-row pages and true total; poisoned Bootstrap is absent
desktop: one presented detail consumer reads fresh goal/acceptance/files, exact Run link and mobile Escape focus
desktop: scope navigation preserves a draft; composing Enter makes no GET and ordinary Enter commits search/page1
desktop: pagination preserves global server order and URL across reload/Back/Forward; page99 clamps without URL rewrite
desktop: 20/50/100 capacities use a single real footer; final Next focus moves to available Previous
desktop: Task/Run/Board presentation state is inert; server-authoritative Unicode/text matches are not browser-filtered
desktop: invalid Inbox type is retained and fails closed until explicit Clear
desktop: unsupported Inbox JQL fails explicitly rather than returning an unfiltered success
desktop: detail 403 exposes read error without list/Bootstrap fallback; Retry reads exactly once
desktop: detail 404 exposes read error without list/Bootstrap fallback; Retry reads exactly once
desktop: detail invalid-2xx exposes read error without list/Bootstrap fallback; Retry reads exactly once
desktop: a fresh completed detail is not actionable in Inbox; its explicit refresh revalidates the eligible list
desktop: missing detail capability uses the admitted full list Task snapshot without Bootstrap supplementation or GET
desktop: same-key removal keeps an explicit selection unavailable instead of silently selecting another Task
desktop: a canceled late detail cannot replace a newer selected Task
desktop: a late obsolete page cannot replace the latest committed query
desktop: failed paging restores read Retry focus and retains the requested page for explicit retry
desktop: delayed paging does not steal user-moved search focus
desktop: list 404 clears old rows and exposes one explicit GET retry without fallback
desktop: list 503 clears old rows and exposes one explicit GET retry without fallback
desktop: list invalid-2xx clears old rows and exposes one explicit GET retry without fallback
desktop: false and absent task_query capability retain the original local Inbox without calling the endpoint
desktop: same-key busy rows/actions are blocked; an8s page GET survives real6s polling without replay
desktop: same-key refreshing details retain content but block their domain actions
desktop: busy pending Task details cannot start the Review context flow
desktop: 403 keeps its query and remains failed across Bootstrap polling until explicit read retry
desktop: non-JSON401 clears private list/detail/search state without replay
